posts.title: Allow me to bust a few myths…
posts.description: Here’s a little piece of my mind, based on some recent inquiries from friends as well as various opinions found online. Shooting in JPEG only—especially if you've got a camera that can generate a custom look, or "recipe"—is valid. posts.title: So you’ve decided to license your photos — Part 2
posts.description: In the first installment of this series, I described my workflow for selecting and categorizing images for commercial and/or editorial licensing. Here we’ll examine what kinds of licensing options you might consider offering, and what specific permissions you are granting with each.

posts.title: “I saw you taking photos, can we get copies?”
posts.description: Even when I’m not being hired to take photos, I often bring a camera to events that I’m attending, and event organizers sometimes approach me afterwards to ask if I’d be willing to share them. I usually accede to that request. However, I do set some healthy boundaries.
